newsitem.title: LATVIA: KAIJA TO APPLY FOR OFFICIAL LIST FRIDAY.
newsitem.headline: KAIJA TO APPLY FOR OFFICIAL LIST FRIDAY.

text.p: Kaija fish cannery said on Thursday that it will submit its application to be included on the Riga bourse's official list on Friday.
"Kaija will tomorrow hand in its official application to the bourse to be transferred from the secondary to the official list," a spokesman for controlling stock owner Ave Lat Grupa told Reuters.
Kaija, an active secondary list stock, is now waiting for its 1996 results to be audited ahead of its shareholders' meeting on April 29.
Ave Lat Grupa controls 60 percent of the fish cannery.
